cases.question: Someone asks which supplied meetings overlap or run back-to-back, excluding cancelled events. Use the CalendarConflictCheck tool on the sample.
cases.local_answer:
The sample has three active meetings (cancelled events excluded), and two of them are related:

- **C1 and C2 overlap.**
- **C2 and C3 are back-to-back.**

C3 does not overlap C1. No calendar changes were made.
